description: Chapter 3 §1.1 says modal auxiliaries use one present-tense form with all subjects and have no third-person-singular -s form. Existing AGR-002 states without a modal exception that a present-tense verb agrees in person and number with its subject.
proposed_resolution: Review AGR-002 and explicitly exclude modal auxiliaries from its present-tense agreement condition, while preserving the distinct agreement forms of be and other inflecting verbs. Do not modify AGR-002 until human approval.
